transport: in-process Python; no RPC, MCP or CLI session service
scope: Immutable preparation only. No treatment or acceptance authorization.

caller_requires: Verify accepted predecessor artifact and its qualification before opening
Retain source catalogue identities and grouping
Read and validate actual artifact bytes through the existing store

open.effects: Allocates bounded cache owners; no geometry computation or verdict

lease.effects: Serializes the full task and validates caches before and after; restores prior ContextVars on exit

requires: Do not wrap this call in context.task; run_t02 leases internally
Existing stage authorization and accepted input binding
outputs: existing T02 result, candidate, plan, verification and summary
run_t02.effects: Runs the existing stage and checks; does not bypass reconstruction or final verification

neighbor_records.python: neighbor_records(scene, original, current, source, policy, build)
outputs: fresh JSON copy of complete neighbor preparation
neighbor_records.fallback: Original builder outside a lease or on cache miss; corruption raises

predecessor_union.fallback: Exact original construction outside lease, on changed dependencies, oversize or unsupported precision

diagnostics.counter_note: Unused Counter keys may be absent; consumers may display them as zero. This is not a verdict.

close.effects: Idempotent cache release; closed contexts reject further leases; evidence and caller-owned geometry stay intact

budgets.semantics: Retained-cache estimates, not total RSS; transient GEOS allocations are separate

error_policy: Precondition failures reject entry. Errors during a leased task close the context and propagate; retain failed evidence. Never silently regenerate corrupt cache contents and report a pass.
not_implemented: Concurrent independent jobs with shared process-global ownership or pin state
A generic stage preparation implementation for T01/T03/T04/T05
